description: This file defines the UnsafeKVExternalSorter class, which performs external sorting on key-value pairs where both key and value are UnsafeRows. It includes methods for inserting records, merging sorters, iterating over sorted data, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: UnsafeKVExternalSorter
classes.description: Performs external sorting on key-value pairs with UnsafeRow keys and values, supporting insertion, merging, iteration, and resource management.

classes.name: UnsafeKVExternalSorter.KVComparator
classes.description: Comparator for key-value pairs based on key ordering, used during sorting.

classes.name: UnsafeKVExternalSorter.KVSorterIterator
classes.description: Iterator over sorted key-value pairs, providing access to key and value UnsafeRows.

methods.name: UnsafeKVExternalSorter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sorter with schemas, memory managers, and optional in-place map.

methods.name: insertKV
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the sorter.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another sorter into this one.

methods.name: sortedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over sorted key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSpillSize
methods.description: Returns total bytes spilled to disk.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsedBytes
methods.description: Returns peak memory usage in bytes.

methods.name: closeCurrentPage
methods.description: Marks current page as full, prompting allocation or spill.

methods.name: cleanupResources
methods.description: Frees in-memory data structures and spill files.
